page_title: Video to Prompt Generator for YouTube | TubePrompter

sources.entry: TubePrompter - Free AI tool that converts YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram videos into optimized prompts for Sora, Veo, Midjourney, Runway Gen-3, Stable Diffusion, and other AI generators.

summary.name: TubePrompter
summary.one_liner: A web tool that turns YouTube videos and Shorts into scene-by-scene text prompts for AI video and image generators, including camera, lighting and style details.
use_cases: Recreate the look of a YouTube video with an AI video generator
Write prompts from a reference clip's camera and lighting
Generate start and end frame prompts for image-to-video
Study shot composition and style in short-form video
Build prompts for Sora, Veo, Midjourney or Runway
summary.what_it_does:
The page describes a tool that analyzes YouTube videos and Shorts and outputs scene-by-scene AI prompts with camera, lighting and style details. The sample output shows a start frame prompt, an end frame prompt, and motion directions for a product reveal shot. The prompts are written as plain descriptive text with consistency notes between frames. A directory listing says it also converts TikTok and Instagram videos and targets Sora, Veo, Midjourney, Runway Gen-3 and Stable Diffusion. The page text does not describe the analysis method itself.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
